stem:
Observe the given figure carefully.

(The figure shows a crucible being heated over a flame, containing a mixture labelled "PbO + Y".)

The residue left behind in the crucible, substance Y and the substance which can replace Y in the above process are respectively

options.label: A
options.text: Brown crystals of \(\text{Pb}_2\text{O}_3\), C and CO

options.label: B
options.text: Shiny globules of Pb, C and Mg

options.label: C
options.text: Black mass of \(\text{Pb}_2\text{O}_3\), CO and Cu

options.label: D
options.text: White powder of Pb, Cu and K
